sections.title: Levels
sections.note: When experience reaches a level's cost, choose which to raise; unspent experience is lost on a game over. Setting a crystal tops it up to the next level.

items.name: Attack
items.howTo: Each level makes the sword stronger.

items.name: Magic
items.howTo: Each level makes spells cost less.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon's old guide gives 1,000 / 2,000 / 3,000 / 5,000 XP for levels 5–8; Zelda Wiki, StrategyWiki and Zelda Dungeon's Magic Level page give the numbers here.

items.name: Life
items.howTo: Each level makes Link take less damage.

sections.title: Link Dolls
sections.note: Six dolls, each an extra life. Once taken, a doll never comes back.

items.name: Moruge Swamp
items.howTo: One step southwest of the boulder in front of the Water of Life cave, just out of the cave south of Ruto.

items.name: Beach by the King's Tomb
items.area: Beach southwest of the King's Tomb
items.howTo: On the beach southwest of the graveyard around the King's Tomb, near the bridge.

items.name: Road to Maze Island
items.area: North coast, on the way to Maze Island
items.howTo: On a patch of desert on the south shore of the path to the Maze Island bridge.

items.name: Southeast swamp
items.area: Swamp north of the gravestones, south of the River Devil
items.howTo: In the northwest corner of the swamp just north of the gravestones.

items.name: Three-Eye Rock Palace
items.howTo: In the rooms before Barba, past a crumbling bridge, guarded by a blue Iron Knuckle and two Bubbles. Gone once the palace is finished.

items.name: Great Palace
items.howTo: Near the end, off an elevator: left to the doll, right to a fairy. Gone once the palace is finished.
